text: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity, commanding good and forbidding evil is charity, your guiding a man in a land of misguidance is charity, your seeing for a man with bad eyesight is charity, your removing a stone, thorn, or bone from the road is charity, and your pouring what remains from your bucket into your brother's bucket is charity."
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "Nothing is heavier on the Scale of the believer on the Day of Resurrection than good character. For indeed, Allah hates the user of dirty and obscene language."
The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "From the excellence of a person's Islam is his leaving alone what does not concern him."
The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Leave what makes you doubt for what does not make you doubt. Verily, truth brings peace of mind and falsehood brings doubt."
